plainLanguage: Section 62 regulates unauthorised training or drilling in arms or military exercises, participation for training, and requires DPP consent before prosecution.
meaning: Ufafanuzi wa section 62 lazima ufuate complete statutory text, qualifications na procedural requirements zake; label ya offence pekee haitoshi.
keyPoints: Subsection (1) addresses trainers and presence for the purpose of training without Ministerial permission.
Subsection (2) separately covers persons trained/drilled or present to be trained/drilled.
Different penalties are stated for subsections (1) and (2).
Subsection (3) requires consent of the Director of Public Prosecutions before prosecution.

legalTerms.meaning: Maana na scope yake huamuliwa na exact wording ya statutory provision na authoritative interpretation.

history.summary: Section 62 is recorded in The Penal Code [CAP. 16 R.E. 2022].
notes: Official text was audited before this explanation was added.

expertPerspectives.label: Mtazamo A
expertPerspectives.view: Each statutory element and qualification should be analysed separately.

expertPerspectives.label: Mtazamo B
expertPerspectives.view: Where the section states a procedural safeguard or consent requirement, it should be treated as part of the legal analysis.

debateQuestion: Je, facts na procedure vinatimiza exact requirements zote za section 62?
disclaimer: Ufafanuzi huu si maandishi rasmi ya sheria.
